user.title: Connect an EZVIZ account
user.description: Connect HG2 gate controllers and their associated CH3 chimes from an EZVIZ account.

error.mfa_required: EZVIZ two-factor authentication must be disabled

init.title: Cloud polling
init.description: Configure how often Home Assistant polls the EZVIZ cloud for this account. Each gate's travel duration and optional BLE fallback are configured on the gate itself (its device page), not here, so multiple gates on the same account do not share the same settings.

user.title: Configure a gate
user.description: Set this HG2's own travel duration and optional authenticated local BLE control. When enabled, BLE is used when EZVIZ reports this HG2 offline, the last cloud refresh failed, or the cloud explicitly rejects a command. The BLE address is optional if Home Assistant can discover the serial number.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure this gate
reconfigure.description: Set this HG2's own travel duration and optional authenticated local BLE control.

abort.no_gates_available: Every discovered HG2 gate on this account is already configured

error.ble_verify_code_invalid: The verification code must contain exactly six characters
